text: Wallpaper Skin 是 DSH 网页插件：它把本地 Wallpaper Engine 媒体用作网页背景，并在“扩展 > 外部”提供壁纸选择面板。插件扫描 Steam 创意工坊缓存和本地项目，支持图片、视频以及兼容场景包中的主纹理；可调整界面底色透明度，预览后再应用或关闭壁纸，并保存所选壁纸和透明度。适合希望用本地壁纸个性化 DSH 网页界面的用户。无需 API 密钥；Windows 自动发现 Steam，非标准路径可设置 STEAM_PATH。

Wallpaper Skin adds a DSH web picker for local Wallpaper Engine images, videos, and compatible scene textures. Choose and preview a background, adjust interface transparency, then apply or disable it. No API key is needed; set STEAM_PATH for a custom Steam location.

Wallpaper Skin 的功能「扫描本地壁纸」：从 Steam 创意工坊缓存和本地项目目录发现图片、视频及场景包；用户打开选择器或重新扫描即可查看清单。
Wallpaper Skin 的功能「设置网页背景」：在选择器点选本地图片、视频或兼容场景纹理，预览后按应用按钮将媒体显示为 DSH 网页背景。
Wallpaper Skin 的功能「调节界面透明度」：拖动 0–70% 滑杆即时预览 DSH 主界面底色透明度，并可与壁纸一起确认保存。
Wallpaper Skin 的功能「播放本地视频壁纸」：选择受支持的视频后，网页以媒体流循环播放；若视频无法加载则回退到预览图。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web plugin that uses local Wallpaper Engine media as the DSH background. It adds a wallpaper picker to **Extensions > External**, keeps the DSH workspace readable with translucent surfaces, and stores the selected wallpaper locally.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · @haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin：> [!IMPORTANT]
> Image projects use their original image and video projects play their original local video. Compatible `scene.pkg` projects use the primary texture stored inside the package. Wallpaper Engine particles, SceneScript, puppet rigs, audio visualizers, and web wallpapers are not executed; unsupported projects retain their preview image.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Features：- Discovers Steam libraries on Windows through `STEAM_PATH`, the Steam registry entry, and common installation paths.
- Scans subscribed Wallpaper Engine Workshop items and local Wallpaper Engine projects.
- Streams MP4, WebM, M4V, and MOV files with browser-native muted looping playback.
- Reads PKGV scene packages and decodes PNG, JPEG, BMP, raw BGRA, and RLE-compressed TEX base textures.
- Opens from the installed `extensions-wallpaperskin` row under **Extensions > External** instead of adding another Settings page.
- Separates the local library and Wallpaper Engine Workshop cache into tabs.
- Stages wallpaper and transparency changes until **Apply wallpaper** is pressed.
- Restores the saved wallpaper and transparency when the dialog is closed or **Restore current selection** is pressed.
- Applies local image, video, or compatible scene media as a full-window `cover` background while keeping DSH content and navigation usable.
- Provides a `0-70%` surface-transparency control. The default is `36%`; the sidebar stays 14 percentage points less transparent for readability.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Requirements：- Windows. Automatic Steam discovery currently targets Windows registry and drive layouts.
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with the web profile.
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`, matching the package engine declaration.
- Wallpaper Engine for Workshop and local-project discovery. The plugin can still load without Wallpaper Engine, but the picker will be empty.
@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Requirements：If Steam is installed in a non-standard location, set `STEAM_PATH` to the Steam directory before starting DSH.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Installation：Install directly from GitHub into the DSH web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin
```

Restart the web application after installation:

```sh
dsh web
```

For a local checkout, clone the repository and link its root directory:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:E:/path/to/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin
```
@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Installation：The repository root is the installable package. There is no nested package directory.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Usage：1. Open DSH and go to **Extensions > External**.
2. Click the `extensions-wallpaperskin` row for `@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin`.
3. Choose **Local library** to see every discovered project, or **Wallpaper Engine** to see locally synced Workshop items. The Workshop link opens Steam when you need to subscribe to more wallpapers.
4. Check the media label on each card: **Original**, **Video**, **Scene texture**, or **Preview only**. Click a card to stage the selection.
5. Adjust **Surface transparency** to preview how much of the wallpaper is visible through the DSH base surface.
6. Press **Apply wallpaper** to save both settings.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Usage：Closing the dialog before applying restores the saved state. **Restore current selection** also discards the staged wallpaper and transparency. **Disable wallpaper** removes the background without deleting any Wallpaper Engine files.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Wallpaper discovery：For every discovered Steam library, the host scans:

```text
steamapps/workshop/content/431960
steamapps/common/wallpaper_engine/projects/myprojects
```

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Wallpaper discovery：The scanner reads `project.json` when present. Image projects use the declared original image. Video projects use the declared video or the first supported video in the project directory. Scene projects follow `scene.json`, model metadata, and material metadata inside `scene.pkg` to find the primary TEX texture. Preview files remain thumbnails and runtime fallbacks.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Wallpaper discovery：Supported image extensions are PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, and AVIF. Supported video containers are MP4, WebM, M4V, and MOV; playback still depends on codecs supported by the browser.

The **Wallpaper Engine** tab is a view of Workshop files already downloaded to the machine. The plugin does not download Workshop items itself. Subscribe or create wallpapers in Wallpaper Engine, wait for them to sync, then use **Scan local library** in the dialog.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Configuration：The host stores configuration in `$DSH_HOME/wallpaperskin.json`. When `DSH_HOME` is unset, DSH's default home is used (`~/.dsh`). A saved configuration looks like this:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "selectedId": "workshop/1234567890",
  "surfaceTransparency": 36

`surfaceTransparency` is an integer from `0` to `70`. `0` keeps the DSH base surface opaque; larger values reveal more of the wallpaper. Invalid or missing values resolve to `36` in the client.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Host API：| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/list` | Rescan and return available wallpapers, Steam library roots, and saved configuration |
| `GET` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/preview/<id>` | Return a wallpaper thumbnail |
| `GET` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/image/<id>` | Return the selected background image |
| `GET` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/media/<id>` | Return an original image, a ranged video stream, or a decoded scene texture |
| `GET` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/config` | Return the saved configuration |
| `POST` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/config` | Merge and save configuration fields |
| `GET` | `/plugins/wallpaperskin/health` | Return plugin health and rendering mode |

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Host API：The API is intended for the local DSH web client. It is not an authenticated public media service. Apply the same network-access controls to DSH that you use for other local-file capabilities.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Architecture：`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the Host plugin into the selected DSH profile. The `dsh.client` fields in `package.json` register the browser half.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Privacy and security：The plugin does not upload wallpapers, send telemetry, or call a remote wallpaper API. Wallpaper metadata, package textures, and video bytes remain on the machine and are read by the local DSH host. The only external navigation is the user-initiated link to the public Wallpaper Engine Workshop.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Privacy and security：DSH serves selected media to its connected web client. Do not expose an untrusted DSH instance to the network, because any client that can reach these plugin routes can request discovered wallpaper media by id.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reporting.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Development：No build step is required. Edit the ESM sources in `lib/`, then run:

```sh
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```

To exercise the plugin in DSH, link the checkout to a disposable web profile, restart `dsh web`, and test the complete selection, preview, apply, restore, and disable flows.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Development：Contributions are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), review the [open issues](https://github.com/haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin/issues), and include focused verification with behavior changes.

@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin README · Project identifiers：- Cordis row id: `wallpaperskin`
- Package: `@haibala-aii/dsh-extensions-wallpaperskin`
- Browser extension row: `extensions-wallpaperskin`
- Host route prefix: `/plugins/wallpaperskin`
